headline: Discussion with Salem City Councillor Jeff Cohen on a municipal wage theft ordinance.
summary: The committee will meet with Salem City Councillor Jeff Cohen to discuss a municipal wage theft ordinance. Minutes from May 18, 2026 are also up for approval.
